accounts.name: pending_lottery_payout
docs: `init_if_needed`: `finalize_lottery_payout` keeps `lottery_draw_epoch`, so a later draw
derives this same PDA. Plain `init` would fail forever on the spent voucher and deadlock
every future claim. The handler rejects overwriting a voucher that is still live.

fields.name: epoch_sell_volume_current
docs: Primary-market sell `amount` only; used with `epoch_turnover_limit` (buy and transfer-hook do not count).

fields.name: lottery_winner
docs: Set when a pending winner first swaps after draw; claim/payout may use this instead of live tickets.

fields.name: genesis_epoch_timestamp
docs: Unix time when protocol **epoch 0** starts. `current_epoch = (now - genesis) / SECONDS_PER_EPOCH`.

fields.name: lottery_ticket_cycle_start
docs: First epoch of the current 7-epoch lottery ticket window (aligned to redistribution cycle).

fields.name: price_floor_accumulated

types.name: TradeBook

fields.name: pending_dex_tax

types.name: VenueKind
docs: Tag for an allowlisted SPL token account (vault/ATA).
- `PrimaryPool`: Meteora-compatible **pool token account** for this mint — hook treats it like
`trade_config.meteora_token_vault` (OfficialBuy / OfficialSell, same limits and accounting).
- `Dex` / `Cex`: optional venues when P2P is off (lighter hook path; not “official” pool).
